claims.text: The Government of Tonga Public Announcement dated 6 January 2025, 'Current Status of His Majesty's Government' (with the Tongan 'Tu'unga 'o e Pule'anga 'o 'Ene 'Afio' of the same date), states that Government resumed work that day, Monday 6 January 2025; that it is in 'caretaker mode' ('tauhi fakataimi') under the Acting Prime Minister ('Palemia Le'ole'o', as printed), Hon. Samiu Kuita Vaipulu, and the current Cabinet Ministers; that no new financial commitments or policies are to be made in the caretaker period; and that the caretaker Government continues until the appointment of Prime Minister Designate Hon. Dr. 'Aisake Valu Eke and of his new Cabinet Ministers is completed, after which the appointments of the current Cabinet Ministers will be revoked.
claims.locator: Image 1 (English), date line and paragraphs 1-5 and 7; image 2 (Tongan), paragraphs 1-5
claims.uncertainty: Attests the arrangement on 6 January 2025. It does not say when Vaipulu began acting, under what instrument, or when the caretaker period ended; the revocation of the current ministers is a forecast, not a dated act. Its final paragraph says the Office of the Prime Minister will issue a Public Announcement in due course of the commencement of the New Government; no such announcement was identified.

scope_note: The announcement is published only as two JPEG images (English 1.jpg, Tongan 2.jpg), still served live. The post page now returns HTTP 404, as does its REST endpoint; it was read from a Wayback Machine capture of the original page (26 January 2025), which embeds both images. The capture is an archive of the PMO page, not a PMO-served copy. The coat of arms is not used.

visual_review.method: Both release images were viewed at full size: the 6 January 2025 date line, the caretaker paragraphs, the named Acting Prime Minister, the forecast revocation and the final paragraph on a later announcement. The coat of arms was not used.
